digest.component_or_area: Data Center Jira backend characterization suite
propositions: DC backend has only shape-level unit coverage while Cloud's characterization suite pins actual values, an asymmetry backwards relative to risk since DC values were never hardened by incidents.
Parametrize the Cloud characterization suite over both vendors at the _backend() seam so each vendor asserts the values it should produce, without editing Cloud's existing passing assertions.

Pin _map_local_to_dc_fields by value for every emitted key including default fallbacks (Task/Medium/To Do) and empty-string fallbacks, and pin both DC sanitizer boundaries at-limit and one-over including the truncation suffix.

Drive the shared map_fields_to_remote body through WikiTextCodec to catch DC composition regressions, pinning the length fit and non-str isinstance guard but explicitly NOT an ordering assertion since WikiTextCodec.normalize_outbound is the identity and makes ordering unobservable.

Pin all four DC probe branches through the real classifier (jira_family.classify_probe_response or a JiraDataCenterTransport over a jira.JIRA-shaped stub) rather than JiraDataCenterBackend(FakeTransport), which unconditionally returns UNREACHABLE.

Prove DC binds its own resolved_statuses using a non-default set since DC's DEFAULT_RESOLVED_STATUSES is byte-identical to Cloud's RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES, making a default-set pin vacuous; each pin must be mutation-checked and recorded on the ticket and in the test file.
